questions.topic: Page 3: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 3-4 Focus)
questions.questionText: What are the coordinates of the origin in a 2-D Cartesian coordinate system?
questions.explanationAnswer: The origin is defined as the point of intersection of the x-axis and y-axis, which is (0, 0).
questions.explanationQuestion: The question asks for the standard coordinate representation of the origin.

questions.topic: Page 3: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 3-4 Focus)
questions.questionText: For any point located on the y-axis, the ______ coordinate must be equal to 0.
questions.explanationAnswer: Points on the y-axis have no horizontal displacement from the origin, meaning their x-coordinate is 0.
questions.explanationQuestion: The question asks to identify the coordinate that is zero for points on the y-axis.
